findings.reason: The cited evidence shows a link alarm and latency alert, but does not establish a causal link between the link degradation and the latency issues.
T3 explicitly states S-SAH-009 dl_volume_mb was below baseline from 2026-09-21 12:30.
ALM-000365 shows the alarm and CHG-2026-0056 shows the upgrade occurred earlier on the same node.
ALM-000366 confirms the major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on LNK-SAH-02-B with the specified start and end times.
ALR-0025 lists the three sites and identifies latency_ms as the metric.
T7 reports no maintenance windows for the listed nodes during the specified time window.
